title: [v0.7.x] Roadmap: Kubernetes runtime
author: mcpdev80
body:
## Purpose

Parent issue for the BaseHarbor v0.7.x Kubernetes Runtime implementation line.

Namespace-only operation remains the primary authorization profile.

Children cover security/networking, exposure, storage, stateful workloads, availability, conformance, portability proof and delegated delivery/GitOps.

Master roadmap: #155

## Foundation and release children

- [ ] #102 — v0.7.0 Kubernetes Runtime foundation and namespace-only access model (implementation/evidence remains outstanding; historical runtime-selection seams are not runtime support).
- [ ] #304–#310 — namespaced security, exposure, storage, stateful workloads, availability, conformance and portability.
- [ ] #325 — delegated delivery / GitOps provider architecture.

Historical v0.4 foundations stay delivered; these open issues own the later Kubernetes implementation. #155 is the authoritative roadmap.
